title: Using Pre-Trained Language Models for Producing Counter Narratives Against Hate Speech: a Comparative Study

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the generation of counter-narratives against hate speech targeting Jews and Muslims, including assessing toxicity and testing zero-shot generalization capabilities via Leave-One-Target-Out (LOTO) experiments.

Evaluating the generation of counter-narratives against hate speech targeting women, including measuring text quality, diversity, toxicity, and evaluating zero-shot generalization via Leave-One-Target-Out (LOTO) experiments.

Evaluating the generation of counter-narratives against hate speech targeting the LGBT+ community, including testing zero-shot generalization to unseen targets via Leave-One-Target-Out (LOTO) experiments.
Evaluating the generation of counter-narratives against hate speech targeting migrants, including testing model generalization on unseen hate targets via Leave-One-Target-Out (LOTO) experiments.
Evaluating the generation of counter-narratives against hate speech targeting People of Color (POC) using overlap metrics, diversity metrics, and toxicity scores.
Evaluating the generation of counter-narratives against hate speech targeting disabled individuals using overlap metrics, diversity metrics, and toxicity scores.
